title: Indirect Connect Handles Wrong Place
description: Indirect connect handle markers appear at incorrect positions in puzzle2d. Fix coordinate space mismatch between cached world-space tiles and indirect ring drawing.
summary: Indirect-connect ghost rings were drawn inside the world-space content cache with screen-space coordinates (then camera-transformed again), and the cache does not rebuild on selection or link-drag moves — so rings appeared offset or on the wrong target. Fixed by passing world_space through append_indirect_handle_ring when embedded in cached geometry, and by painting the ring each frame in a screen-space overlay in append_cached_world_content (same path as the live link wire). Added board_host_indirect_ring_paints_without_rebuilding_world_cache regression test.
